_comment: This build is only used to generate compile_commands.json for clangd
and should not be used for any other purpose.
Note the `flutter/tools/font_subset` target is only used because if no
targets are specified, the build will fail, and if an empty list of
targets are specified, all targets are built (wasteful/slow)
The build runs under Bazel (--bazel among the tools/gn flags; flutter/build/bazel/ci.md):
the install lays font_subset, and the compile_commands.json step makes the database from
the build's action graph (tools/gn_to_bazel/tool/compile_commands.py: the generated file
clangd_check reads, the assets fixtures' source, built for it), as GN's gn gen wrote it.
use_rbe: true syncs reclient and its configurations, which the wrapped GN builds (the GL backends') name among their inputs
whether or not they run on RBE; --no-rbe keeps the recipe from starting a proxy, and the Bazel build runs no remote action here.
name: ci/linux_unopt_debug_no_rbe
